name: updateItemsAdvanced
description: Changes several seminar items at once, up to 50.

items.description: The items to change and what to change on each, up to 50 at a time.

itemId.description: The item's id, as shown in search results.

newTitle.description: The item's new title. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newSummary.description: The item's new summary. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newDescription.description: The item's new formatted content. Leave it out to keep the current content, or leave it empty to remove it.

newPublishDate.description: The new publication date shown on the item. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newReleaseDate.description: The new day the item appears in the app. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to always show it.

newListImage.description: The new picture shown for the item in the list, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newCarouselImages.description: The item's slider pictures, in order, each with its picture and what tapping it does. Replaces the current ones; leave it out to keep them, or pass an empty list to remove them.

newLinks.description: The item's links, in order, each with a title. Replaces the current ones; leave it out to keep them, or pass an empty list to remove them.

newBackgroundImage.description: The item page's new background picture, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when all the items are done.

error.description: Why nothing was changed, such as an unknown item id.

items.description: One result per item, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which item this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The item's id, if it was changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, if it wasn't.
